messages:
maria: Heads up — PM sync with Acme today. They want stronger tenant isolation options without a 2x cost hit. Need a short proposal we can show.
aj: Do we have intermediate options that avoid full physical siloing? logical slices + throttling + cache partitioning maybe?
sam: We should bake in failure isolation tests. Last time one noisy tenant evicted shared cache and tanked tail latency for everyone.
li: Runtime note — we already support kv-prefix caches and per-tenant pinning. Measured cost delta: ~15–30% vs full GPU split depending on batching shapes.
maria: Goal: define launch criteria + phased rollout. Can we agree on gates? thinking: SLA guardrails, perf regression <5% on key signals, cost uplift <30%.
aj: Proposed gates:
- Canary with 1 customer (start in non-prod -> move to prod)
- Latency P95 <= baseline + 25ms
- Cost per request delta <30%
- Ops runbook + automated rollback scripts
- Telemetry: per-tenant tail latency, cache spill rate
oliver: Acme will accept staged rollout if we can promise deterministic throttling and egress controls. They also care about data residency for EU workloads.
sam: Ops ideas:
- Eviction throttles: enforce per-tenant cache quotas
- Quarantine on OOMs: route tenant to degraded model variant automatically
- Auto-fallback: route to cheaper/compatible model when capacity constrained
li: Quick config sketch for routing policy:
```yaml
routing:
  policy: tenant_slice
  slice_key: customer_id
  slices:
    - name: default
      capacity_ratio: 0.8
    - name: high_iso
      capacity_ratio: 0.2
``` 
aj: @li nice. Also need ordering for model variants and a runtime flag to enforce strict isolation (no cross-tenant KV reuse). We should surface that as `strict_isolation: true` in config.
maria: How many pilot tenants to validate SLOs? I suggest 3 pilots: small, medium, large (by qps footprint).
li: Agree — run pilots across 3 regions (us-west, us-east, eu-west) to validate routing + failover semantics.
sam: SRE checklist for pilot:
- synthetic traffic replay + production-sized traces
- chaos: CPU/GPU pressure during canary
- dashboards per-slice (latency, errors, spill, OOMs)
- alerting thresholds and automated rollback hooks
maria: Prioritization note: prefer reusable infra that solves many customers. If only a tiny fraction need full physical isolation we avoid making that the default. Product asks prioritized: 1) soft isolation with guarantees 2) hard isolation as paid add-on 3) UI controls for tenants.
oliver: Pricing: propose an "Isolation Add-on" (monthly seat/tenant) + usage uplift. Sales wants a concise doc for renewals and pre-sales conversations.
aj: Risk register notes:
- complexity explosion of routing policies
- cost unpredictability for customers on soft isolation
- operational difficulty for autoscaling and scheduling
sam: Mitigations:
- start with single simple policy `tenant_slice`
- telemetry-driven gating before wider rollout
- auto-fallback to elastic pooled capacity for transient spikes
maria: Action items:
- @aj draft architecture brief (2p) by EOD Fri
- @li sketch runtime flags + config examples by Tue
- @sam produce pilot SRE runbook by Wed
- @oliver pricing bullets + customer comms draft by Thu
I'll sync with Acme Thurs 11am.
deploy-bot: Reminder: RFC template at https://redwood.infra/rfcs — tag drafts with `isolation-pilot` for discoverability.
aj: Ack. I'll include tenant migration path -> hard isolation and compatibility matrix.
li: Also check KMS scoping for Private deployments; customers asking for key separation if they require hard isolation.
sam: Define clear rollback triggers: sustained P95 > baseline+50ms for 10min OR error rate >1% for 5min triggers immediate rollback.
maria: Thanks all — keeping scope narrow for MVP. Reconvene Mon to review draft artifacts. :thumbsup:
